name: Diversity
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s creation encompasses a rich diversity of peoples and roles, all made by and for Christ (Colossians 1:16). This diversity includes cultural distinctions such as Greeks and Jews, bond and free, yet in Christ these divisions are transcended (Colossians 3:11). Believers are called to unity of mind and humility toward one another, accepting those weak in faith without judgment (Romans 12:16; Romans 14:1). Furthermore, God commands justice and equity for all nations, inviting every people to praise Him (Isaiah 56:1; Psalms 117:1).
